limitations: This source-bound performance analysis is not a provider aggregate success and does not qualify later source 4f3 or close physical/human acceptance.
Every displayed_fps is null. Headless draw absence and graphical software submissions are not physical scanout, monitor refresh or human input-to-photon latency.
Actual worker participation is maximum distinct task-claiming workers per native dispatch, not configured capacity, utilization or worker occupancy.

Active/idle pairs are compared only when all recorded source/config/runtime/platform/CPU/backend identities agree; they are separate jobs without established same-machine, cache, CPU-clock, contention or randomized replicate controls.
Native/ANGLE, Windows/Linux and different CPU models are distinct cohorts. No timing improvement, compiler-only speedup or causal production optimization is inferred.
Snapshot publication age, retained render-buffer age and revision lag are distinct. An old retained render timestamp can accompany zero revision lag when unchanged cells reuse the render buffer.
Main wait observations cover snapshot mutex acquisition/critical sections only; they do not inventory every lock or explain all frame stalls.
Brush command admission does not prove individual native application. Registered activity is supported by measured native cell work and source-bound owner observations.
Input latency is admission to a completed physical application, excluding physical device delivery and display scanout. The 29 applied samples per case do not establish a tail guarantee.
Process duration includes startup, test execution and retirement; construction acknowledgment is a separate Build-to-ready callback observation, not a compiler-only measurement.
No original failure or idle adverse-control rejection was dropped or converted into a passing active-workload observation.

method.input_window: All 29 applied events in the complete 40-event tape, including lifecycle/reset sections; differs from the measured native/Rapier/draw window.
method.numerical_reduction: Native/Rapier measured-window counts, participation, CPU timing, snapshots and draw distributions recomputed from raw fixture rows; each input latency rejoined from sealed outcome ID/ordinal to raw admission and completed physical step. All recomputed fields agree with original retained reductions.
method.percentiles: Nearest rank: sorted observations[ceil(n*p/100)-1]. No pooling of per-case percentiles.
method.rates_window: Actual retained ~15-second measurement interval, not process duration or configured target cadence.

provider_complete_inventory.scope: Latest observation supplied by root when this analysis began; not relabeled from local reduction.
